title: Kinetics of electron-phonon scattering in silicon resolved by Rydberg transitions of donors
summary: Rydberg states of atoms in vacuum are now well recognized as a resource for quantum technologies. Donors in semiconductors also display analogous states, which have been proposed for similar applications. While they benefit from permanent locations in their host crystals, electron-lattice coupling leads to much shorter excited-state lifetimes than for neutral atoms in vacuum. Here we provide a quantitative description of donor-phonon kinetics, creating a basis for engineering donor systems in realistic material stacks for quantum devices.
